title: He only talks to you and says don't tell anyone
scenario: An online friend you met through a game has become your main confidant. Lately he's started asking for photos and says it has to stay a secret between just the two of you, or he'll be hurt that you don't trust him.

answers.A: Send one photo to prove you trust him, then stop.
answers.B: Keep it secret since he asked, and see where it goes.
answers.C: Don't send anything, and tell a parent or trusted adult about the conversation, even though it feels private.

explanation: Asking to keep a relationship secret from the people who protect you is a warning sign on its own, whatever else is happening in the conversation.
proTip: Anyone who needs you to keep them secret from your family is asking for something they know is wrong.
